title: Robert Saleh will ease Titans' draft picks into rookie minicamp to avoid injuries

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh will ease Titans' draft picks into rookie minicamp to avoid injuries
sources.description: In 2015, Robert Saleh was the Jaguars' linebackers coach when they used the No. 3 overall pick in the draft on pass rusher Dante Fowler.
